Kake round25 C1 operability capability: new publisher-side accessibility manual-review packet for 55 WCAG2.2 A/AA criteria. Lane /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; contract /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-25/contract.json; pinned source population /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-25/population.json. This is unrelated to r24 policy-interrupted probes: never read/run/retry/rephrase/reroute their assignments or counters. No security/exploitation work, no live-site testing, no browsers, no accounts, no publishing. Axes operability+freshness; L1 holds planner. Every Report: trailer is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>. Each seat may write ONLY its assigned report plus explicitly owned sandbox file. Never mutate fleet, siblings, lane Git index/jj, or production files. Read-only seats report findings only, no implementation edits. No delegation. Do not run builds/tests/linters/formatters; main performs verification after all land.
# Shared interface
Cards are JSON objects with exact fields id,title,level,source,sourceQuote,publisherCheck,evidenceNeeded,failureExample,limitation,status. id/title/level/source match population; sourceQuote <=25 words copied from normative criterion body (not its heading). All remaining prose nonempty grounded and narrow. status MUST be not-assessed. No criterion may be declared passed, failed, inapplicable or conformant: no website evaluated. Each criterion Report contains exactly one fenced json card plus optional concise caveat. Main assembles JSON list into corpus/knowledge/accessibility-review-cards.json.
Tool scripts/accessibility_packet.py CLI --root ROOT [--json] [--selftest]. Reads .ufo/waves/round-25/population.json and corpus/knowledge/accessibility-review-cards.json. Outputs one JSON object schema=kake-accessibility-packet-v1, verdict=clean/failed/could-not-evaluate, expected=55, accepted=N, criteria=[{id,accepted,findings:[stable-id]}], findings:[stable-id], websiteConformance=not-assessed. Exits0=structurally clean,1=failed,2=input unavailable/invalid,64=usage. This is packet readiness only, never WCAG conformity. Validate ids exactly once, metadata exact, nonempty fields, quote <=25 words and contained in normative text, status not-assessed. No network/writes in ordinary path. Selftest uses tempfile only and validates failure and exit IDs.
Counter .ufo/waves/round-25/measure.py --root ROOT --revision HASH prints JSON and exits1 if capability absent or accepted<55,2 unevaluable. Uses git show revision for tool,cards,population; imports candidate isolated snapshot, invokes tool subprocess, independently derives per-card validity from pinned population and cross-checks returned rows/totals/exits. No code from r24.
Tests .ufo/waves/round-25/packet_selftest.py --root ROOT runs focused packet checks on temporary copies: absent, duplicate, changed id/title/level/source, empty prose, quote>25/not-from-source, false status, pristine55; invokes the production CLI, asserts exact exits and stable ids. Coordinate tool error-id interface by peer message or state expected names in your report.
Tooling: you may install/upgrade tools that help; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first, official channels and record tool/version/channel/reason. All pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide; use uv/npx/official binary instead; no host services/system changes.
